DogF (own COI)
    Loading the registry…Dog records are kept in this page's database. If nothing appears, the records have not been loaded yet; add a dog to start.

    Litter COI is Wright's coefficient computed from every record in the registry (kinship of sire and dam, tabular NRM method). Where founders are truncated it is a floor, not the true value.

    Records from Serendipity's ADBA certificate 16193AP-84 and Cooper's Buck's seven-generation certificate 15894AP-59; ADBA certificates take precedence over platform data. F and COI are recomputed live from the records whenever one changes.
